name: Harbinger Cabal
legend: Ominous heralds on missions of acquisition for their dynastic betters or the Nekrosor itself, cabals of Crypteks wield technosorcerous ingenuity. The space lanes and hidden sites of Ultramar are preyed upon by many such groups whose unliving soldiery attack with reality-warping augmentations.

rules.name: Arcanoscientific Expertise
rules.legend: Dispatched to acquire eldritch artefacts in the deadliest of confines, Crypteks augment their immortal retinues with their arcane technical knowledge and devices, ensuring they are sufficient to dominate the vessels and complexes they invade.
rules.description_html:
In your Command phase, for each Cryptek unit in your army, select one of the following abilities. Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has that ability.
  • Hyperlocation Stutter (Aura): While a friendly NECRONS unit is within 6" of this model, add 2 to Advance rolls made for that unit.
  • Transharmonic Disruption (Aura): While a friendly NECRONS unit is within 6" of this model, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of weapons equipped by models in that unit.
  • Quantum Interface (Aura): While a friendly NECRONS unit is within 6" of this model, models in that unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: HOLOGYRIC SIMULATION
stratagems.legend: By creating a bubble of cycling holographic simulations, a Cryptek can analyse thousands of minutely varying outcomes in a moment, ensuring they or their servants can exploit their foes' weaknesses.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if your unit is within 6" of a friendly Cryptek unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll. If your unit has the CRYPTEK keyword, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

stratagems.name: ANTI-PROXIMAL SUBROUTINES
stratagems.legend: To counter the close-quarters threats in the depths of enemy vessels, Necrons employ firing patterns to scour enemy positions regardless of their proximity.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability.

stratagems.name: DYNAMIC RECONFIGURATION
stratagems.legend: When a Cryptek's foes threaten to thwart their schemes, rapid reassessment of the situation ensures the most effective technoarcana is employed.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Start of any phase.

TARGET: One Cryptek unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one of the abilities from the Arcanoscientific Expertise Detachment rule. Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has that ability instead of any others from the Detachment Rule.

stratagems.name: CONTINUUM REALIGNMENT
stratagems.legend: Crypteks use strange technologies beyond the ken of other species, and are capable of altering space-time itself to ensure they are exactly where they need to be.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: End of your Fight phase.

TARGET: One Cryptek unit from your army.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".

enhancements.name: Cryptometric Experimentation
enhancements.legend: This Cryptek's living metal body has long been the foundation for their most ingenious alterations.
enhancements.description_html: Add 1 to the Toughness and Wounds characteristics of the bearer. The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save.
enhancements.description_text: Add 1 to the Toughness and Wounds characteristics of the bearer. The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Portal Transmuter
enhancements.legend: With a gesture, the bearer of this device can cosmically link one doorway to somewhere else entirely.
enhancements.description_html: Once per turn, when the bearer ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 3" of an open Hatchway or when the bearer opens a Hatchway, it can, before any units decide if they wish to fire Overwatch, use this ability. If it does, remove the bearer from the battlefield and set it back up on the battlefield wholly within 3" of another open Hatchway and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. When doing so, if the bearer cannot be set back up on the battlefield, it is destroyed.
